facts.value: Persistent settings live in gmMainLib_804D3EE0->modes.vs_camera. CSS and SSS entry callbacks copy this record to scene payloads; accepted exits copy selections back. Match preparation copies rules and players into StartMeleeData and installs camera callbacks. Match exit consumes gmVsMelee_VsExitInfo.match_end through result helpers, passes persistent settings to gm_80168710, updates KO counts, and selects state 1.
facts.rationale: Corrects direction: match_end is consumed from the shared exit record, not newly folded into it by this callback; source explicitly exposes persistent settings and KO update inputs.

facts.value: Coordinates GM_CAMERA_MODE scene selection and VS setup, installing Camera Mode pause, frame and match-start hooks and snapshot resources. The installed camera frame-update path delegates to a camera UI state table whose normal state reads controller index 3 for B and Z; Z enters a snapshot capture sequence. This unit wires those mechanics into the match rather than implementing the camera UI itself.
facts.rationale: Pins controller-index-3 snapshot behavior through the installed camera update callback. Avoids treating function-name overlays as evidence for camera motion or a menu category.
